timingProtocol.freshProcess: first import in a new child process; OS file cache is uncontrolled
timingProtocol.repeatInProcess: subsequent imports of the same file in the same child process
timingProtocol.processMemory: process lifetime high-water marks sampled immediately after import, before semantic hashing
timingProtocol.elapsedTime: steady-clock wall time in CPU preparation, including reads and excluding scene destruction
timingProtocol.allocations: when enabled, replaceable C++ allocation calls and requested bytes on the preparation thread; collect timing with the uninstrumented target
timingProtocol.semanticDigest: FNV-1a-64 of selected ordered source and prepared scene fields, per section
